method: A forward path is kept only when the anchor is an independent dated event (purchase screenshots, issuer retail launch, or publication date) and is labeled as not personal P&L. Month-placeholder and unverified-exit anchors have returns, rating windows, and Wikipedia windows set to null.
limitations: Placeholder dates do not produce returns or dependent windows.
Dorel adjusted closes are not comparable to the nominal $1.56 screenshot; factor, currency, identity, and quote quality are unresolved.
Missoni equity path uses Target's 13 Sep 2011 launch, not a verified option fill. Rating counts from the old 7 Sep anchor were invalidated rather than reused.
TPR path and the recomputed rating and pageview windows use the 18 Aug 2021 publication date, not a fill.
Yahoo rating history is incomplete. An empty window is insufficient evidence, not silence.
No costs, borrow, or option Greeks. Not a backtest and not a buy.
